reference_algorithm: unchanged fused Perminov-55 from 6D/6E retained evidence; not executed in this attribution capture

nsight.cuda_graph_trace: graph:host-only in session 1; node:host-only in session 2
nsight.capture_range: one NVTX MI6F_TRACE range covering only measured blocks

profiled_relative_baseline: median of the first four graph-level blocks in session 1 only
classification_notes: The 65/80 us bands derive from 6D/6E staged observations and are descriptive only under profiling. A graph-level relative anomaly requires at least 1.35 times the fixed first-four median. Node-level captures are interpreted within their own traced session. A slow unprofiled block is not inferred from a profiled event value alone.
limits: Maximum two fresh processes, twelve measured blocks per session, two node-level traced blocks per session. No waiting or repeated capture to force a slow block.
